displayName: MDO - Suspicious Inbox Rule After Phishing Click

queryCondition.queryText:
let Clickers = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(3h)
    | where ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware") or (isnotempty(IsClickedThrough) and IsClickedThrough != "0")
    | summarize ClickTime = min(Timestamp) by AccountUpn
    | where isnotempty(AccountUpn);
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(3h)
| where ActionType in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule", "UpdateInboxRules")
| extend Rule = tostring(RawEventData.Parameters)
| where Rule has_any ("ForwardTo", "RedirectTo", "ForwardAsAttachmentTo", "DeleteMessage", "MarkAsRead", "MoveToFolder")
| extend Upn = tolower(AccountDisplayName)
| join kind=inner (Clickers | extend Upn = tolower(AccountUpn)) on Upn
| where Timestamp between (ClickTime .. ClickTime + 6h)
| project Timestamp, ReportId, AccountObjectId, AccountUpn, ClickTime, ActionType, Rule, IPAddress

alertTemplate.title: Inbox rule created after malicious link click
alertTemplate.description: A user who recently clicked a malicious link then created an inbox rule that forwards, redirects, deletes or hides mail - a hallmark of Business Email Compromise / account takeover.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Remove the malicious inbox rule, reset the user's credentials, revoke sessions, and review OAuth grants and mailbox delegates for additional persistence.
